I'll start by reading the docs and the existing code.

Output was truncated; let me read the middle of the spec and the rest.

I'll write the files with the edit tools instead.

I finished `export` and it follows `docs/export.md`, but one existing test now fails because it contradicts the spec. `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` runs 28 tests and 27 pass.

The failing test is `test_split_into_files` in `tests/test_export.py`. It expects files named `people-001.csv`, but section 10.3 of the spec requires `people.slice-001.csv`. I followed the spec and left the test alone, since I can't change anything under `/app/tests`.

Beyond the unit tests, I ran the command by hand on the `orders` collection in `/app/store`. I tried the `en-IN` locale, `--sort` with null placement, tab delimiter with `--null`, `--where` with `not`, and a bad `--where` (exit status 2). I also tried `--max-rows`, which gave `o.slice-001` and so on for a path with no suffix. I did not test every combination of options.

What I changed under `/app/tally`:
- **`--where`:** `evaluate` is written. A test on a null value is false except `is null`, and `not` simply inverts the result.
- **Number patterns:** the expression parser now accepts only ASCII digits in numbers.
- **Locale text:** grouping uses `group_sizes` and `min_grouping`, and `--no-grouping` switches it off. Date and datetime patterns now follow section 7.4. Canonical dates no longer use `strftime`, which doesn't zero-pad years below 1000.
- **CSV:** the `csv` module didn't follow section 8, so I replaced it with a small writer. Records end in CR LF, fields starting or ending with a space or tab are quoted, and a field equal to the null token is quoted.
- **`--sort`:** `nulls-first` and `nulls-last` were being flipped by `:desc`. They now apply whatever the direction. Without a placement, nulls sort as the largest value.
- **`--max-rows`:** files are named `.slice-NNN` before the suffix, with at least three digits.
- **Store reading:** `tally/store/store.py` used `splitlines()` on part files, which would also split on characters like U+2028 inside a JSON string. It now splits on `\n` only. The `/app/store` data has no such characters, so this didn't change any output there.

I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

What I changed under /app/tally:

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='tally/export/text.py'
s=open(p).read().replace('from datetime import date, datetime','from datetime import datetime')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tally/export/csvtext.py'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('def record')
s=s[:i]+'''def _field(text: str, delimiter: str, null: str) -> str:
    needs = (
        delimiter in text
        or any(c in text for c in ('"', "\\r", "\\n"))
        or text[:1] in (" ", "\\t")
        or text[-1:] in (" ", "\\t")
        or text == null
    )
    if needs:
        return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text


def record(fields: list, delimiter: str, null: str) -> str:
    """fields: texts, or None for a null value. Ends with CR LF (section 8)."""
    parts = [null if f is None else _field(f, delimiter, null) for f in fields]
    return delimiter.join(parts) + "\\r\\n"
'''
s=s.replace('import csv\nimport io\n\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tally/export/order.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''            if x is None:
                c = -1 if nulls_first else 1
            elif y is None:
                c = 1 if nulls_first else -1
'''
new='''            if x is None or y is None:
                # Placement is independent of the direction (section 6.3);
                # without one, nulls count as larger than any value.
                first = (not desc) is False if nulls_first is None else nulls_first
                if x is None:
                    return -1 if first else 1
                return 1 if first else -1
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tally/export/expr.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('_NUMBER = re.compile(r"-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?")','_NUMBER = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?")')
s=s.replace('c == "-" or c.isdigit()','c == "-" or c in "0123456789"')
s=s.replace('(text[end].isalnum() or text[end] in "_.")','(text[end].isalnum() or text[end] in "_.")')
i=s.index('    raise NotImplementedError("export --where')
s=s[:i]+'''    kind = node[0]
    if kind == "or":
        return evaluate(node[1], record) or evaluate(node[2], record)
    if kind == "and":
        return evaluate(node[1], record) and evaluate(node[2], record)
    if kind == "not":
        return not evaluate(node[1], record)
    value = typed(record, node[1])
    if kind == "isnull":
        return value is None
    if kind == "notnull":
        return value is not None
    if value is None:
        return False
    if kind == "in":
        return any(value == v for v in node[2])
    if kind == "notin":
        return all(value != v for v in node[2])
    op, lit = node[2], node[3]
    if op == "=":
        return value == lit
    if op == "!=":
        return value != lit
    if op == "~":
        return lit in value
    if op == "<":
        return value < lit
    if op == "<=":
        return value <= lit
    if op == ">":
        return value > lit
    if op == ">=":
        return value >= lit
    raise ValueError(f"unknown operator {op}")
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tally/commands/export.py'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('def part_paths'); j=s.index('def run')
s=s[:i]+'''def part_paths(path: Path, count: int) -> list[Path]:
    name = path.name
    dot = name.rfind(".")
    stem, suffix = (name[:dot], name[dot:]) if dot > 0 else (name, "")
    width = max(3, len(str(count)))
    return [path.with_name(f"{stem}.slice-{i:0{width}d}{suffix}") for i in range(1, count + 1)]


'''+s[j:]
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tally/store/store.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('text.splitlines()','text.split("\\n")')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat tally/export/csvtext.py | tail -22; grep -n 'first =' tally/export/order.py

cd /app && sed -i 's/first = (not desc) is False if nulls_first is None else nulls_first/first = desc if nulls_first is None else nulls_first/' tally/export/order.py && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /app && cat store/orders/schema.json | head -30; python -m tally export orders --locale en-IN --limit 2 2>&1 | head -3; python -m tally export orders --locale en-IN | head -8; python -m tally export orders --sort 'status:desc:nulls-last,id' --columns id,status | head -8; python -m tally export orders --where "not status = 'open' or status is null" --columns id,status --null NULL --delimiter tab | head -5; python -m tally export orders --out /tmp/x/a.b/o --max-rows 40; ls /tmp/x/a.b
